name: Wall, diagonal run
description: One tile of a Stone Wall that runs diagonally (point 41, m-hradby-diagonala): a wall from corner to corner of the tile, turned 45°, as tall as the wall block, with a parapet on both long sides. Tiles of a diagonal run touch at their corners; these pieces join them into one straight wall. Drawn on the tile's centre. Made by Claude with the wall-kit generator at the owner's request (15 Nov 2026: "připrav je ty"); waits for the owner's approval.

variants.name: Run down the screen
variants.notes: Towards grid (x+1, y+1). On screen the wall runs straight down, seen from its end.

variants.name: Run across the screen
variants.notes: Towards grid (x+1, y−1). On screen the wall runs straight across, seen from its face.
